column3: To exercise general supervision and control over all programs, projects, services, and activities of the municipal government, enforce all laws and ordinances relative to the governance of the municipality and the exercise of its corporate powers provided for under Section 22 of the Local Government Code.
To provide efficient, effective and economical governance with service-oriented, transparent and accountable public servants.

To assist the Local Chief Executive in the administrative aspects of management and exercises general supervision and control over all municipal government departments and sections to the purpose of ensuring delivery of effective basic services to constituents.

To regulate the entry and operations of all business establishments in the municipality through the undertakings of business tax assessment, issuance of business permits and licenses, monitoring and imposition of mandatory standards to ensure compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations in order to protect the interests of the public and to promote commercial activity for the general welfare of the municipality of Tigbauan.

To effectively assist the LCE in achieving an ethical, economical, efficient, and effective administration of its affairs, ultimately fulfilling the LGU’s goals through an objective and proactive audit.

To provide legislations for adequate, dedicated and responsive public public service and enable our citizens to live in comfort, security, maximum utilization of resources, active people's participation and active partnership with  other government organizations and the private sector.
Formulate integrated economic, social, physical, and other development plans and policies for consideration of the local development council

To provide a first class civil registration system where, with the use of modern technology, access to data concerning the civil status of persons and those events affecting such status, can be accessed if not instantaneously, within a brief and reasonable period of time,and to develop relevant programs and activities which would help intensify civil registration.

column1: OFFICE OF THE MUNICIPAL BUDGET OFFICER
column3:
To review and consolidate budget proposals of different departments and offices of the LGU and assist the LCE in the preparation of the annual and supplemental budgets.
Study and evaluate budgetary implications of proposed legislation and submit comments and recommendations thereon and act as member of the Local Finance Committee

To maintain a system of accounting and internal control that provides timely and authentic financial information to our local legislators and other stakeholders to guide them in their decision–making process for the benefit of the general public.
To generate more revenues thru efficient collection of taxes in accordance to existings laws and ordinances of the Municipality to sustain its economic growth

To increase revenues by appraising and assessing all real properties for taxation purposes and conduct general revision of all real property by classification by applying approved schedule of market values every three (3) years.

To establish a solid foundation for a strengthened and empowered human resources of the Local Government based on public ethics standards and excellence under a sustainable, transparent and accountable public service.
To deliver efficient and effective employment ands its related services for the provision of a better quality of life among Tigbauenos.

To provide all departments of the Local Government Unit of Tigbauan with the necessary logistical requirements that would enable them to deliver their services and implement their programs in a timely, effective, efficient and adequate manner.
To provide delivery of efficient, cost effective, sustainable thru universal  quality health care services to all Tigbauanon in collaboration with NGOs and other GO's

column1: OFFICE OF THE SOCIAL WELFARE AND DEVELOPMENT OFFICER
column3: To care, protect and rehabilitate that segment of the population which has the least in the life, in terms of physical, mental and social well-being as such, it has always developed programs and services focused on the disadvantaged, with strategies along the rehabilitation of individuals, families and communities.
To deliver gender responsive, climate resilient extension services for sustainable agriculture and fisheries sector in the municipality

To provide professional engineering, administrative and technical support services to facilitate the provision of sustainable, suitable and affordable infrastructure in a manner that will result to a greater autonomy for communities.

column1: MUNICIPAL ENVIRONMENT AND NATURAL RESOURCES OFFICE
column3: To ensure the protection, conservation, and management of the environment and natural resources, coordinating with government agencies, non-government organization, and the private sectors in the implementation of measures to prevent and control land, air, and water pollution. It is also committed to the provision of extension to beneficiaries of forest development projects and technical, financial, and infrastructure assistance; and the implementation 10-year solid waste management plan of the Local Government Unit.

To encourage, promote, and develop tourism as a major socio-economic activity to generate foreign currency and local employment and to spread the benefits of tourism to a wider segment of the population with the support, assistance, and cooperation of both the private and public sectors.
To build a Disaster Risk Management and Climate Change Adaptation Capabilities with cooperative partners in the protection of the vulnerable residents.
